resources.string: Paste an RSS feed, or a link from Apple Podcasts or Spotify. Tip: in Spotify, tap Share → LingoPod.
Follow a podcast and new episodes are downloaded and transcribed on your phone, with a translation under every sentence. Nothing is sent to a server.
Search millions of podcasts. Results come from the open Apple Podcasts directory; the app plays each show\'s public RSS feed.
Downloaded episodes and transcripts of this podcast will be deleted.
New episodes are prepared in the background
Transcribed sentences appear below as they\'re ready.
Runs on your phone; you can leave the app and keep listening.
Create one on your phone. The episode is downloaded first if needed.
What\'s already transcribed is kept. Continue whenever you like.
Tap any word in a transcript to translate it, then save it here.\n\nExport the list (tab-separated) to import into Anki or another flashcard app.
Downloads ~30 MB per language the first time it\'s used
Transcripts are made on your phone. Bigger models are more accurate but slower. The selected model downloads automatically the first time it\'s needed.
Fastest. Lower accuracy; fine for slow, clear speech.
About 3× slower than Base, noticeably more accurate.
Best Whisper accuracy, slow. Needs a phone with 8 GB RAM.
Fast and very accurate, with punctuation. 25 European languages (including Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, English); not Japanese or Chinese.
A ggml Whisper model file you imported yourself.
More cores is usually faster, up to the number of fast cores in your phone. Use the speed test to compare.
Flash attention for Whisper models. Whether it helps depends on the phone: compare with the speed test.
Finds the speech first, so only the talking is transcribed: faster, and nothing made up over music. Turn it off if bits of speech get missed (talk over loud music).
Transcribes the same 30-second Italian recording: one warm-up run, then 3 timed runs (the middle one is shown), so you can compare models and settings.

Recommended: lets long transcriptions finish while the app is closed. Tap to allow.
What the app did, step by step. Share it if something goes wrong.

LingoPod plays public podcast RSS feeds. Speech recognition (Whisper or NVIDIA Parakeet) and translation (ML Kit) both run on this phone. Models are downloaded once; audio and transcripts never leave the device.
Progress of episode downloads and on-device transcription
%1$s doesn\'t support %2$s. Choose a Whisper model in Settings.
Sample: Luigi Pirandello, “Novelle per un anno”, read by a LibriVox volunteer (Multilingual LibriSpeech, CC BY 4.0).

Parakeet v3 on the phone\'s AI chip (Qualcomm NPU): the heavy part runs on the NPU, the rest on the CPU. Potentially several times faster and lighter on the battery. Large download (2.3 GB); the first use prepares the NPU, which can take a few minutes.
CPU cores used: automatic (%1$d fast cores)

This phone has %1$d fast and %2$d efficiency cores. Recognition runs on the fast cores; audio preparation, speech detection and saving run on the efficiency cores. Using more threads than fast cores usually makes it slower.
Episodes, models and feeds download on Wi-Fi only; streaming on mobile data asks first
Uses mobile data when there\'s no Wi-Fi
Wi-Fi only mode: it will download when you\'re on Wi-Fi
Wi-Fi only mode: the translation model downloads on Wi-Fi
Wi-Fi only mode is on. Stream this episode over mobile data anyway, or download it when you\'re on Wi-Fi?
Records ONNX Runtime and Qualcomm messages when the NPU is tried
Checks the phone\'s NPU setup now and shows every NPU attempt
Paused while LingoPod isn\'t on screen — open the app to continue
Off: only the transcript is shown and nothing is translated (tapped words are still translated)
Languages: 99, including all %1$d in this app
Choose one or more languages. Each gets its own library of podcasts and its own flashcards; switch between them with the flags.
Transcription and translation run on your phone. No account, no tracking. Details: Settings → About.
Fill either box; the other is translated
Nothing estimated at %1$s here; showing all levels.
CEFR level (A1 = beginner … C2 = near-native). Used to suggest podcasts; you can skip it.
Stops at the end of the sentence being spoken, with a short fade.
Alibaba SenseVoice: very light and fast (one pass, little battery), excellent for Japanese, Chinese and Korean.
Japanese only, trained on 35,000 hours of Japanese TV: small, efficient and very good on natural speech. No punctuation.
Whisper large-v3 distilled for Japanese: accuracy close to large-v3 at about Turbo speed.
Uncompressed Whisper that can run on the graphics chip (switch on “Use the graphics chip” below). Compare with the speed test.
For Whisper “· GPU” models, on Snapdragon (Adreno). Falls back to the CPU if the phone doesn’t allow it.
The speed test uses an Italian recording, which %1$s doesn’t understand. Switch to a language it supports (e.g. Italian) to test.
Helps improve LingoPod: which features and speech models are used and how fast they run. Never podcast names, searches, transcripts or saved words. You can change this any time in Settings.

Meta Omnilingual: 1,600 languages, including Armenian. Better than Whisper Base for Farsi, Hindi, Georgian and other languages. No punctuation: sentences are cut at pauses.
No offline translation for %1$s yet: the transcript is shown without translation
Listen today to begin your next streak.
Day-by-day history starts with version 0.15; earlier listening counts in the total.

LingoPod → Anki

1. Unzip this file.
2. Copy the files in media/ into Anki's collection.media folder (Anki: Tools → Check Media → View Files).
3. In Anki: File → Import → cards.txt. Fields: Front, Back, Sentence, Sentence translation, Audio (tab-separated).
Saved without the speaker\'s audio: the episode is downloading for next time
Tap another word to adjust, or long-press and slide again
Download the speech model %1$s first (Profile → Speech models)
The speech model is busy transcribing; try again in a moment
The speaker\'s audio needs the episode downloaded
Your recordings stay on this phone.
Each language has its own podcasts, saved words and speech model. Tap here to switch, for example to Japanese or Armenian, or to add a language.
Find podcasts by category and level. Shows are checked to really be in the language you learn.
In Profile → Speech models, each language offers three: Light (small, fast, saves battery), Balanced and Best (most accurate, bigger download). Everything runs on your phone.
Words and sentences you save become flashcards with the speaker\'s own voice.
Profile → Statistics shows your listening time, streaks, records and podcasts.
Tap a word to see its meaning and hear it. Tap a sentence\'s time to play from there.
Text size, translation under each sentence (double subtitles), word highlighting, furigana or romaji, and shadowing a sentence.
Previous / next sentence, repeat the sentence, and speed. The picture button switches between the cover and the transcript.
Length unknown: download the episode to move through it
You\'re not on Wi-Fi. This download uses your mobile data allowance, and your operator may charge extra depending on your plan.
Shows the size of a download and lets you wait for Wi-Fi
The speech model runs on your phone. It is downloaded once.
Free transcription used: 30 minutes this week (resets on Monday). LingoPod Pro has no limit.

The Best speech model for every language
Unlimited saving and shadowing of phrases (free: 5 a day)

Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions. Prices include taxes where applicable.

Unlimited transcription, Best models, Anki export

1. Long-press the first word you want.
2. Without lifting your finger, slide to the last word, even into the next sentences.
3. Lift your finger: the selection is translated right away.
4. Then Save (a card with the speaker's voice), Shadow, or Copy.
Long-press a sentence's time to take the whole sentence.
If your selection crosses two sentences, you can remove the "." or "?" the transcription put between them.
To fix a word or a name, select it and tap the pencil.
Names the speech model may not know: hosts, guests, places. One per line. Names in each episode\'s title and notes are used automatically.
Fix a misheard word or name. Names you correct are remembered for this podcast\'s next episodes.
Some sentences came out in English. Download NVIDIA Canary (210 MB), a small model that is told the episode\'s language, to rewrite them automatically.
Whisper Large v3 is slower than real time on most phones: best for episodes downloaded in advance.
OpenAI\'s largest Whisper, the most accurate in every language. Large (1.08 GB) and slow on phones.
Transcribed on your phone: mistakes happen, especially in fast conversations. To fix a word, select it and tap the pencil.
Words you haven\'t marked Familiar or Known get a light tint. Tap a word to rate it.
You know %1$d%% of the words · %2$d new words
Tap a word to see it in context and rate it.
How well do you know it?
Jump over ads found in the transcript (otherwise a Skip ad button appears).

Many podcasts sell an ad-free version as a private RSS feed (Patreon, Supercast, Acast+…). If you have one, copy its feed address from that service and add it here: you\'ll get the episodes without ads.
Canary 180M (NVIDIA): a small model told the language, used to redo the sentences Parakeet writes in English. French, Spanish, German.
Also records every sentence, why one was taken for English and what was redone. Stays on your phone; it\'s only sent if you share it.
When Parakeet writes a sentence in English, redo it with NVIDIA Canary (210 MB), which is told the language. Adds a few seconds per minute of audio; turn off for maximum speed.
Listening in a language other than your native one earns 10 coins a minute (listening in your native language earns nothing). Spend them on bait and catch fish for your tank.
Welcome gift: %d coins for what you\'ve already listened to.
Your tank is empty. Catch your first fish!
Double coins for your next %d min today
Today\'s double coins are used. Back tomorrow!
Three of the same fish merge into one of the next rarity. Tap a fish marked ⬆.
It got away. Your bait is still on the hook.
Too early! Wait for the float to dip.
Lucky catch: guaranteed after 10 casts without a rare fish.
You get a free Worm cast for every 30 minutes of listening and for each episode you finish. Next one in %d min.
After 10 Worm casts without a Rare fish, the next one is at least Rare (%1$d of %2$d).

When a word doesn\'t exist (probably misheard), that sentence is heard again by a second model told the language: NVIDIA Canary for English, French, Spanish and German, otherwise a downloaded Whisper model (Turbo, Small or Base). One-letter slips of common words are corrected. Adds a few seconds to some blocks.
This word doesn\'t exist: it was probably misheard.
Maybe it was (tap to correct the sentence):
Colour words by how common they are
Green: the 1,000 most common words of the language. Blue: up to 5,000. Purple: up to 15,000. Rarer words stay plain: learn the coloured ones first.
Checked on your phone: a real word that makes sense in the whole sentence (translated there and back). A good sign, not a proof.
Sharp ear! You caught a transcription mistake.
Corrected. (This word was already rewarded, or today\'s 20 rewards are used.)
Future episodes of %s will write it right.
The meaning couldn\'t be checked: no translation for this language on the phone yet.
“%1$s” isn\'t a word the app knows in %2$s.
That sounds too different from what was heard here.
The translator doesn\'t know this word in this sentence.
The sentence doesn\'t make sense with this word (checked by translating it there and back).
Corrected. Coins are only for listening in a language you\'re learning, not your native one.
